title: DiscoveryDoc
description:
The `--collect-only --report-json` discovery document (schema 1). Field
order is alphabetical to match the historical `serde_json::Map` output
(serde_json has no `preserve_order` here), so the emitted bytes are
unchanged by the move to a typed struct.

collect_errors.description: Per-collector import/collection errors (empty on a clean collection).

meta.description:
Envelope: producer, document kind, schema version, rootdir and test
count.

tests.description: One entry per collected test item, in collection order.

CollectError.description: A collection-time error (one collector that failed to import/collect).

path.description: The path pytest was collecting when it failed.

file.description: Absolute source file, or empty when pytest reported no location.

lineno.description: 0-based definition line, or null when pytest reported none.

markers.description: All pytest marker names on the item (own + inherited).

DiscoveryMeta.description: Envelope metadata for the discovery document.

rootdir.description: Absolute project root; `file` paths are resolved against it.
